usdc_borrow_debt.meaning: outstanding USDC borrow debt of the Portfolio Margin account that must be netted out of reported backing

pm_supplied_principal.meaning: principal bridged to HyperCore and held in Portfolio Margin supplied positions

reported_backing.meaning: backing amount reported by the accountant for the vault

distributed_yield.meaning: yield amount distributed to Foundation, Insurance Fund and sUSDM

borrow_socialized_to_holders.meaning: the ignored borrow debt is effectively socialized to USDM holders while false surplus is distributed as yield

assumptions: Reported backing is intended to be net of the Portfolio Margin borrow debt per the security intent.
The borrow debt and supplied principal are both denominated in USDC so their amounts are comparable.
Yield distribution occurs after the borrow exists and after backing is reported.

unresolved.description: Report does not quantify the borrow debt, reported backing, or distributed yield amounts; only symbolic amounts can be bound.
Report does not state who triggers the PM borrow or whether it is attacker-controlled, so no actor qualifier is encoded.

limitations: Conservation is expressed at the amount level; the report gives no numeric values, so symbols remain unconstrained beyond the stated relations.
The socialization of borrow debt to USDM holders is represented by a grounded occurrence Boolean because the report states the qualitative outcome without a numeric per-holder definition.
Only the borrow_debt_socialized impact is formalized here; other impacts are out of scope for this plan.
